svg.title: Branches as a draft copy of the menu board
svg.desc: Two lanes. Main: commit 1 Add menu and commit 2 Add hours, then later commit 5 Merge cold coffee and commit 6 Add photos. The cold-coffee branch starts as a copy of main after commit 2 and gets commits 3 Add cold coffee and 4 Price it at 180, which are merged back into main in commit 5. Steps: git branch and git checkout to make the draft, commit on it while main stays the same, then git checkout main and git merge cold-coffee.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Branches: work on a draft copy, keep main safe

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: Every dot is a commit (a save point). Numbers = the order they were made. Colour = the branch they were made on.

-apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
text.tspan: 📋 Like Vidyarthi Bhavan's menu board: customers read the wall menu (main), you change a paper draft (a branch),
and the wall is updated only when the owner approves it (merge). Commits 1 and 2 were already on the wall before the draft existed.
